notes.title: Chinese, Indonesian, and Korean language support update!
notes.notes:
Jumpscare Simulator is now fully playable in the following languages!

- Simplified Chinese

- Indonesian

- Korean

Thank you so much to everyone from these countries who purchased and showed great interest in the game. I was aware of your requests for language support and didn’t want to leave them unanswered!

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: A Small Request About Refunds After Playing
notes.notes:
Hello!

First of all, I want to sincerely thank everyone who played the game, left a review, purchased the supporter edition, and supported me in any way. Thanks to you, the game is reaching more players, and that means an incredible amount to me.

I’d like to kindly share a small request. The game offers around one hour of gameplay, which means it can be completed within Steam’s refund window. Of course, this is entirely your legal right, and I fully respect that.

However, please know that I developed this game completely on my own — through months of hard work and many sleepless nights. I’ve priced it as low as possible so that everyone can access it. That’s why, while it’s your right, completing the game and then requesting a refund can be really discouraging and unsustainable for indie developers like myself.

Your support, feedback, and understanding mean a lot to me. I hope this little note is taken simply as a heartfelt message and not misunderstood in any way.

Wishing you lots of fun, and with love!

notes.title: Day One Update
notes.notes:
Day One Update

With the first-day update, the following issues have been completely fixed:

- The issue of switches turning on and off in the final section.
- Puzzle pieces falling into unreachable areas during interactions.
- Minor visual issues.
- Music and sound balance problems.

Additionally:
Some extra support has been added to improve the user experience.

I am working hard to provide you with a better experience. Please don't hesitate to report any bugs you encounter.

notes.title: Store Page & Current Development Status
notes.notes:
Our store page went live on February 27th!

I’d like to share the latest development status of the game, along with estimated pricing and release date information.

[i][b]The game is fully completed and functional at this stage.[/b][/i] Until the release, we will continue working on localization, optimization, and polish. Additionally, we’ll be making updates based on community feedback. [b]If you’d like to be part of this process, check out the pinned post in the community section!
[/b]
The expected price of the [b]game will be $2 USD. [/b]Pricing has been a tough decision for me, but in the end, as a gamer, I wanted to side with the players. I hope, with your support, all these sleepless nights will be worth it!

Since I developed this game entirely on my own, your feedback and suggestions mean a lot to me. You can reach me at info@durultay.com or leave a comment under the pinned community post.

Looking forward to seeing you soon! 🚀
